name: update-axonhub-openclaw-plugin-for-openclaw-2026-4-29
title: Update AxonHub OpenClaw plugin for OpenClaw 2026.4.29
description: Update and verify the AxonHub OpenClaw provider plugin against OpenClaw 2026.4.29. Use the local sibling OpenClaw repository at ../openclaw and upstream https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw as references. Preserve existing AxonHub behavior: dynamic model catalog, max context/output metadata, reasoning support including xhigh-capable models, package manifest, and security constraints. Include release-ready validation. The coordinator is authorized to push to origin after verification.
creator: openclaw
notes:
Inspected the published openclaw@2026.4.29 npm tarball and local ../openclaw plugin SDK sources to compare against the current AxonHub plugin. The published package still exposes the same plugin-sdk entry points used here (plugin-entry, provider-model-shared, provider-auth, provider-entry), and the local SDK types still include ProviderResolveDynamicModelContext, ProviderAugmentModelCatalogContext, supportsXHighThinking, isModernModelRef, wizard metadata, and manifest-compatible provider env/setup surfaces. Based on that inspection, no code API adjustments were required in index.ts, provider-catalog.ts, or onboard.ts beyond retaining the existing 2026.4.26 compatibility fixes. Release metadata was bumped to OpenClaw 2026.4.29 and plugin version 1.0.3 in package.json, package-lock.json, and openclaw.plugin.json. Trellis implement/check context files were cleaned of the seed example and replaced with real spec references. Validation target commands: npm run validate:manifest, npm run typecheck, and package/manifest version checks.

Coordinator verification on 2026-05-01: npm install, npm ci --ignore-scripts, npm run validate:manifest, npm run typecheck, explicit package/lock/manifest 2026.4.29 metadata checks, git diff --check, and npm pack --dry-run all passed. npm audit reports 5 moderate vulnerabilities through openclaw@2026.4.29 transitive dev/peer dependencies; npm audit fix --force would downgrade OpenClaw to 2026.4.15, so it was not applied.
